answer: Honeypot-and-spot-check audit resists sybils: the system plants decoy challenges with a known answer and spot-checks a random sample of submissions, so an identity that takes the bait or fails a surprise re-grade is flagged. A farm relaying one controller's playbook answers the honeypot in lockstep, a whisper of coordinated identities all crossing the same bridge. Spot-check sampling means the count of audited heads rises with farm size, so a mesa of fakes cannot all stay hidden. Precondition: honeypots are identical to real challenges and the sample rate makes farm-wide escape improbable.
